question: Where can I get a list of commercial ports in Spain, with location, port authority and annual cargo, passengers and vessel calls?

answer.summary: For the 46 state-owned ports of general interest (28 Port Authorities), Puertos del Estado publishes everything asked, per port: an ArcGIS FeatureServer (port points, AP, cargo t, TEU, vessel calls, passengers, 2010-2024) and the Anuario 2025 XLSX (2025 data, coordinates in degrees-minutes). Regional (non-state) commercial ports have no national list; only Catalonia, Galicia and Canarias (passengers) were found, partially.
main_caveats: The ArcGIS traffic table stops at 2024; the Anuario 2025 XLSX (embedded in the PDF) has 2025. Monthly summaries exist per Port Authority, not per port.
Puertos del Estado data covers only the 46 state ports; commercial ports run by regions (e.g. Palamos, Garrucha, Ribadeo) are in separate regional sources.
Port coordinates are whole or decimal arc-minutes (about 1-2 km); Anuario sheet 2_1 has Arinaga at 25º24W (wrong, about 737 km offshore).
'Vessels' are merchant ship calls, not unique ships; passengers are movements. Glossary says gross weight excludes tares, tables footnote says tares included.
No open licence: puertos.es aviso legal requires prior written authorisation for reproduction/exploitation; the ArcGIS item states no licence.
answer.confidence_reason: State-port answer verified by download and cross-checked (2024 total matches in two sources); regional coverage is a sample of 4 of ~10 coastal regions.

attributes.note: Point in degrees-minutes (arc-minute precision) per state port; service-zone polygons in rank 4. None for regional ports.
attributes.gap_note: Regional ports: coordinates not found in the regional sites opened; Valencia, Basque Country, Cantabria, Asturias, Murcia not opened.

attributes.note: Autoridad_Portuaria column per port (28 APs) in rank 2 table; regional ports have regional agencies instead.
Tonnes per state port, 2010-2025. Regional: Catalonia (4 ports) yes; Galicia summary only; Eurostat gives a different scope.
attributes.gap_note: Cargo per regional port not opened for Andalucia, Valencia, Basque Country, Cantabria, Asturias, Balearic and Canarias regional ports.

attributes.note: Non-cruise and cruise passengers per state port; regional: Catalonia yearbook, ISTAC for Canarias regional ports.
attributes.gap_note: Regional ports of other regions not opened.

attributes.note: Merchant ship calls (number and GT) per state port; Catalonia regional ports in its yearbook.
attributes.gap_note: Calls for regional ports of other regions not opened; ISTAC set is passengers only.
